header: Verbund+ for groups with over 15 practitioners
subheader: Rehabilitation centres, hospital outpatient departments, charitable providers and practice groups across several towns.
lead: Above 15 practitioners, the questions are about procurement: sign-on, data processing, audits and payment terms. A person answers them in writing before you sign anything.
note: A written offer is valid for 60 days and fixes the price for its term, usually 24 or 36 months. The offer, security questionnaire and pilot are free.

capabilities.title: Single sign-on
capabilities.text: SAML or OpenID Connect with your own directory. The practitioner list stays in sync automatically.

capabilities.title: Data-processing agreement
capabilities.text: Our standard agreement, or yours reviewed and countersigned. Sub-processors are listed and change only with 30 days' notice.

capabilities.title: A named contact
capabilities.text: One person who knows your installation and can be reached directly. A named deputy covers absences.

capabilities.title: Invoice on account
capabilities.text: Payment terms of 30 or 60 days, your purchase order number on every invoice, and one invoice per cost centre if needed.

capabilities.title: A test installation
capabilities.text: A separate system with pseudonymised copies of your data, for training and for testing new releases before your staff use them.

capabilities.title: Audit export
capabilities.text: Every access to a patient record, exported as a signed log for your auditors.
